title: Ringed total-to-native-total representative and naturality
statement: Under normalized complex comparisons A [lem-sf-native-weil-tensor-ringed-complexes] and supplied ringed one-K-flat representative coherence cB, the inverse ringed representative followed by the inverse localized A.chain gives an isomorphism from the ringed derived tensor of localized EQ and EP to the localization of E(total T(P,Q)), for native K-flat P and arbitrary Q. This explicit two-factor isomorphism is natural under maps in both inputs. No existence theorem selects its data.

proof.text: Apply cB.tensorIso to (EQ,EP), using A.flat P in its second factor. Compose its inverse with the inverse of the localization of A.chain P Q.
